name: Grazing Deer
source: Pathfinder Adventure: A Fistful of Flowers
description: A herd of deer exits the woods to investigate the delicious-looking leshys.
disable: Diplomacy (with Wild Empathy) to befriend the deer and convince them that leshys aren't for nibbling, or Intimidation to scare away the deer.
routine: (2 actions) The grazing deer takes one action to move about, and then one action to eagerly nibble at a randomly chosen PC. A character who spends three actions on their turn to Stride can avoid being nibbled by the grazing deer during the hazard's next turn. If all of the PCs do so, attempt a DC 5 Flat -on a success, the party escapes the deer and can proceed onward to Petalbrook, but they become delayed as a result of having to flee the pack of ravenous deer.

generalAbilities.name: Approach and Taste
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The PCs emerge from the forest's edge

Effect A deer approaches the party and attempts a nibble Strike against a randomly determined PC. The grazing deer rolls initiative.

hp.note: (if the grazing deer take this much damage, they aren't killed, but they do flee into the woods and don't return)
